notes.title: Cursed Arc - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
I'm currently working on a new game, Cursed Arc, which is under development.

In this game, the player would be inside a game (yes, a game within a game). The player would have a main house, which serves as a teleportation hub. The world would be a vast open-world map, featuring an underground realm and a world above the sky. The player must explore, uncover story clues, break the curse, and return to the original game world. But that won’t be easy!

As a fantasy game, it will feature extremely challenging enemies that can only be defeated through strategic thinking. The player will also gain a companion, another trapped soul, imprisoned by an Otherworlder—a being far superior to humans.

If you’d like to support the game, consider purchasing it on Itch.io for a custom amount:
🔗 [url=https://harsh27.itch.io/mystictown-theabyss]Itch.io (click)[/url]

Any support would mean a lot ( as I'm working alone it is kind of hard to manage everything )—thank you!

notes.title: Intergalacto-1: The 2.0 Expansion
notes.notes:
Intergalacto-1 Major Update -2

The UI has been improved for a better experience.

In Boss Mode, all lag has been removed, making it more optimized.

In Mystic Town: The Abyss, we’ve added more content and included an option to remove the invisible ghost and town guardians.

Mystic Town: The Abyss is now optimized for low-end PCs, allowing maximum graphics settings.|

In Battle of Lives mode, a double jump has been added, and players can now dash by pressing ‘C.’

This update includes many other changes to enhance gameplay and also all the artwork have been improved and updated!

Thank you for your support. Download now and experience the latest update (Game is at sale at the moment) !


And get ready—our next game is coming in mid-2025!

notes.title: THE CHANGE
notes.notes:
Update Highlights: Major Improvements and New Features!

Following a challenging launch day, we’ve made significant updates to enhance your gaming experience and bring more excitement to Intergalacto-1. Here's what's new in this update:

Major Changes:

Demo for Mystic Town: The Abyss – Experience a preview of our horror mode with a newly added demo.


Underground World – Explore new areas beneath Mystic Town in our new underground world.
Enhanced Animations – Enjoy additional animations and fun features in Mystic Town.
Extended and Improved Ending – Discover a more engaging conclusion to Mystic Town's storyline.
Optimized Performance – We’ve fine-tuned the game for a smoother experience with reduced lag.

Small Changes:

Bullet Trace in Multiplayer Warzone Mode – Added visual bullet traces to improve gameplay clarity.
Improved Localization – Enhanced translations and localization for Warzone, Zombie, Boss INM, and Battle of Lives modes.
AND a lot of small changes!


We’re committed to making Intergalacto-1 a fun and engaging experience for all players. 
Enjoy these new updates!

next update coming soon!
